keystone_host.description: Hostname or IP of the Keystone control plane node.

keystone_auth_port.description: Port for the Keystone authentication API.

nova_service_password.description: Password for the Nova service user in Keystone (required for auth).

nova_rabbit_password.description: RabbitMQ password for the Nova user.

nova_rabbit_host.description: Hostname or IP of the RabbitMQ node.

nova_db_password.description: Database password for the Nova user.

nova_db_host.description: Hostname or IP of the database server.

nova_api_bind_host.description: Network interface to bind the Nova API on this compute node (e.g., eth0 IP).

nova_api_port.description: Port to listen on for the Nova compute API.

nova_api_db_connection.description: Optional separate DB connection for API data. If empty, uses main nova DB.

glance_host.description: Hostname or IP of the Glance image service.

libvirt_cpu_allocation_ratio.description: Overcommit ratio for CPU cores (e.g., 16.0 = 16 physical cores = 256 virtual cores).

libvirt_ram_allocation_ratio.description: Overcommit ratio for RAM (e.g., 1.5 = 15 GiB allocated per 10 GiB physical RAM).

libvirt_disk_allocation_ratio.description: Overcommit ratio for ephemeral disk (1.0 = no overcommit).

libvirt_live_migration_enabled.description: Enable live migration of instances between compute nodes.

libvirt_live_migration_bandwidth.description: Max bandwidth (MB/s) for live migration. 0 = unlimited.

libvirt_live_migration_tunnelled.description: Tunnel live migration traffic over SSH (for security).

migration_ssh_username.description: SSH user for live migration between compute nodes.

neutron_host.description: Hostname or IP of the Neutron control plane.

neutron_service_password.description: Password for the Neutron service user in Keystone.

metadata_proxy_shared_secret.description: Shared secret for Neutron metadata proxy (must match neutron.conf).

nova_console_host.description: Hostname or IP where novncproxy is exposed (for console access).

vnc_server_listen.description: Address VNC server binds to (e.g., instance IP, or 127.0.0.1 for local-only).

vnc_server_proxy_client_address.description: Address the VNC proxy client should connect to (often same as listen).

vnc_token_ttl.description: Token validity time (seconds) for VNC console access.

serial_console_enabled.description: Enable serial console access (for debugging or OS installation).

serial_proxy_host.description: Host to bind serial console proxy to.

scheduler_default_filters.description: List of scheduler filters to apply during scheduling decisions.

scheduler_weight_classes.description: List of scheduler weight classes for scoring hosts.

scheduler_resource_tracking_interval.description: Seconds between host resource updates sent to Placement service.

placement_os_region_name.description: Keystone region name for the Placement service.

placement_service_password.description: Password for the Placement service user in Keystone.
